name: Progress MS-34
about: Progress MS-34 (2026-093A), a crewed vehicle (Progress MS), launched 2026 Apr 25. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2026 Apr 28), held fixed
docked to S26400; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
